description: Seek's own commands plus the core defaults. Without a capability file Tauri v2 grants the webview nothing at all, and every invoke fails. The two window permissions are what `data-tauri-drag-region` invokes to move the window and to zoom it on a double-click; core:default does not include either, which is why the window could not be moved. The six window setters are Mini Seek's (src/data/miniWindow.ts): it shrinks this same window, can keep it on top, and puts the full frame back.
